title: Siman 325
section: The Virtue of Those Who Drew Close to Him

segments.he: עַל גּדֶל הַיִּסּוּרִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שֶׁאָמַר שֶׁהוּא מֻכְרָח
segments.en: (35.) He said to me when I asked him whether I should talk with people: He answered me "Yes, talk. I asked him: But I do not know what goes on with the other person. He replied: You do not need to know. I asked him: What do I help him? He replied: What does that have to do with you?" [in Yiddish: "shmus ya. ich vais ober nit vos yenem geit op. du darfst nit visn. vos helf ich im. vos hot dos tsu dir"]. And I understood his intention — that he meant to say: "You certainly do accomplish."
